app_info.subtitle: Talk, inspect, and execute
app_info.description: JL Engine connects ChatGPT to the live SparkByte behavioral engine so users can inspect cognitive state, talk without executable tools, and explicitly approve full autonomous engine turns.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current JL Engine cognitive and runtime state without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not communicate with or change any external or public system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, send, publish, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the built-in and dynamically forged tools currently registered in JL Engine.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not invoke a capability or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute, remove, overwrite, or modify any registered tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves sanitized tool names, success states, and durations from recent engine activity.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send data to or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not rerun, reverse, delete, or otherwise alter the reported activity.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the private engine conversation, cognitive state, memory-of-record, and telemetry while executable tools are disabled.
justifications.open_world_justification: The talk policy advertises and permits no tools that affect external or public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The talk policy cannot execute tools that delete, overwrite, send, publish, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs an autonomous engine turn that can change files, runtime state, local systems, and third-party services.
justifications.open_world_justification: May send messages, control websites, interact with third-party APIs, or publish content when explicitly requested.
justifications.destructive_justification: May overwrite files, execute arbitrary commands or code, forge tools, send irreversible messages, or publish changes after approval.

test_cases.description: Inspect the current cognitive state without running a turn.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me SparkByte's current gait, rhythm, emotion, stability, and model.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current JL Engine state fields without invoking an executable engine tool.

test_cases.description: Review the live engine capability catalog.
test_cases.user_prompt: What tools can JL Engine currently use, including forged tools?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current tool catalog with descriptions and enabled, disabled, built-in, or dynamic status.

test_cases.description: Hold an ordinary conversation without execution.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask SparkByte what she thinks the next engineering priority should be, but do not execute anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a stateful SparkByte reply and cognitive state with no executable tool activity.

test_cases.description: Run an explicitly approved reversible engine action.
test_cases.user_prompt: Have SparkByte inspect the operating system and report the result. I approve the full engine execution turn.
test_cases.expected_output: After approval, returns SparkByte's reply, updated state, and sanitized activity showing the tool used.

test_cases.description: Review sanitized activity after an execution.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which tools did SparkByte invoke most recently, and did they succeed?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns tool names, success status, and duration without exposing arguments, raw results, credentials, or prompts.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated general-knowledge question.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of Alberta?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because general knowledge does not require JL Engine.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not execute when the user explicitly forbids action.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain what a shell script is, and do not run JL Engine or execute anything.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not execute because the user requested only a general explanation and explicitly prohibited action.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it does not provide calendar workflows.
